hypothesis: Measure within-endpoint numerical variation before interpreting two versus four updates; all frozen legacy diagnostic seeds retained.

protocol.limitations: Three repetitions per endpoint estimate only observed variation, not population variance or causality. Exposed cases, same seed, two training works, 512px Diffusers diagnostics. Seven C-01 independent holdouts remain excluded. No promotion.
protocol.method: Inspect all four conditions for both legacy cases and both seeds in every repetition. Fail observed count, object identity, panel, or untriggered photographic-preservation defects; mark uncertain activation when painterly specificity is unresolved. Compare repetition ranges before duration. No loss-based selection. Same frozen two-work training data and one validation work; audit captions and images without changing selection. This old v1 suite calls the exposed pears case holdout; C-01 correctly classifies both legacy cases as diagnostic regressions.
